verdicts.reason: Both break the design in the same way. The text has been pulled out of the label frame, so the frame sits empty with its orphaned divider rules floating inside. The illustration of bottles and lavender, which carried the original, has shrunk to a tiny strip with a large dead area of background below it, and 'Homemade Lotion' hangs left-of-centre in empty space. A is slightly less bad because the LAVANDER wordmark is larger and SKINCARE is readable, although 'J'adore Paris' is tiny and squeezed beside it. In B the wordmark row is smaller and SKINCARE is shrunk to near-illegible type crammed against the right edge.
